question: How does admin add, update and delete shared todos?

sections.title: Add a shared todo
sections.beforeHtml: Use this when the task belongs to the whole trip and should later be assigned to one participant.
items: Open the toolbar Trip menu and select Trips.
Select the trip you want to work in.
Open the toolbar Trip menu again and select Shared todos.
Click the Add button with the plus icon. The Add Trip Shared Todo form opens.
Enter the shared todo name. You can also fill category and notes.
Plantour saves the shared todo in that trip and returns you to the Shared todos list.

sections.title: Update a shared todo
sections.beforeHtml: Use this when the shared todo already exists and you want to change its details.
items: Open Trip > Shared todos for the selected trip.
Select the shared todo you want to change so it is highlighted.
Click the Update button with the pencil icon. The Edit Trip Shared Todo form opens.
Change fields such as name, category, or notes.
Plantour saves the shared todo and returns you to the list.
sections.afterHtml: Changing who is responsible for a shared todo is handled on the Shared todos list itself, not inside the add or update form. For the assignment workflow, continue with How does admin assign shared todos?.

sections.title: Delete a shared todo
sections.beforeHtml: Use this when the trip no longer needs that shared task.
items: Open Trip > Shared todos for the selected trip.
Select the shared todo you want to remove so it is highlighted.
Click the Delete button with the trash icon.
Plantour removes the shared todo from that trip.
sections.afterHtml: If the todo was already accepted by a participant, review the assignment state first because shared todos are tied to acceptance and assignment status.
